s='''def transform(grid):
    src=[row[:] for row in grid]; a=[row[:] for row in grid]; R=len(a); C=len(a[0])
    counts={}
    for row in src:
        for v in row: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    # Marker is the least frequent nonzero color; the dominant color is background.
    nonzero=[v for v in counts if v!=0]
    if not nonzero: return a
    col=min(nonzero,key=lambda v:counts[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if src[r][c]==col]
    for dr in range(-R,R):
      for dc in range(-C,C):
        q=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in pts]
        if all(0<=r<R and 0<=c<C for r,c in q) and all(src[r][c]==0 for r,c in q):
          for r,c in q: a[r][c]=col
    return a
'''
p.write_text(s); print(p, p.stat().st_size)
